name: How to Convert PDF to Word Free
description: Convert a PDF to an editable Word document (.docx) free — no upload, no account, processed entirely in your browser.

tool.name: PDFree — free browser-based PDF to Word converter, no upload required

step.name: Open your PDF
step.text: Click 'Choose PDF' or drag your file into the drop zone. The PDF loads in your browser — nothing is uploaded anywhere.

step.name: Choose Text or Image mode
step.text: Text mode creates an editable Word document with paragraphs, headings, and tables. Image mode preserves the exact visual layout as page images — useful for complex or scanned PDFs.

step.name: Download the .docx file
step.text: Click 'Convert to Word'. The .docx downloads automatically. Open it in Microsoft Word, Google Docs, or LibreOffice — no paid software required.
